From the bar

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

A sushi bar on Nikolaou Laniti

Cowfish Restaurant is a small place on Nikolaou Laniti 7A in Larnaca: a counter where the chef prepares the food in front of the guests, a green and purple dining room and a dragon on the wall. In the restaurant’s own words: Japanese cuisine with a flair for the experimental. On Google, guests mention the sushi, the salmon and the tom yum most often, and the menu runs from sashimi and rolls to poke bowls, ramen and fried rice.

Open Tuesday to Sunday from noon, until ten in the week and until eleven from Friday to Sunday. Closed on Mondays.
